sources.entry: InvoiceShelf - Track expenses, payments & create professional invoices & estimates (fork of Crater). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: InvoiceShelf is a self-hosted web application for creating invoices and estimates, tracking payments and expenses, and managing customer accounts, forked from Crater.
summary.what_it_does: The app creates invoices and estimates and exports them as PDFs. It records payments and shows what each customer still owes. It tracks expenses, taxes, and business reports, and can schedule recurring invoices. Customers get a portal for invoices, estimates, and payment history, and one installation can manage multiple companies with team members invited under scoped roles. Version 3.x adds EN 16931 e-invoices (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDFs with XML embedded) through an official E-Invoicing module that requires the Gotenberg PDF driver.
use_cases: Send professional invoices and estimates to clients
Track customer payments and outstanding balances
Schedule recurring invoices for repeat clients
Run invoicing for several companies from one install
how_to_run: Open the app in a browser and finish the setup wizard
notable: Customer portal for invoices, estimates, and payment history
Multiple companies with scoped team roles
ZUGFeRD / Factur-X hybrid e-invoices with EN 16931 XML (3.x, via official module)
Fork of Crater with a focus on self-hosted data ownership
Official Docker images with SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL options
caveats: The 3.x branch is an alpha preview, not for production data; use 2.x for production
E-invoicing requires the official E-Invoicing module and the Gotenberg PDF driver
UBL formats and Peppol sending are planned but not yet available
